verses.sloka: पुनः प्राप्ते वसन्ते तु पूर्णः संवत्सरोऽभवत् ।प्रसवार्थम् गतो यष्टुम् हयमेधेन वीर्यवान् ॥१-१३-१॥

translations.english: After completion of one year when spring returned, the valiant king (Dasaratha) entered the sacrificial pavilion to worship celestial beings for begetting sons.
translations.hindi: बालकाण्ड का ग्यारहबाँ सगं समाप्त हुआ द्वादशः सर्ग; ततः काले बहुतिथे कस्मिंश्चित्सुमनोहरे । वसन्ते समनुप्राप्ते राज्ञो यष्टुं मनोऽभवत्‌

translations.english: "O foremost among ascetics O brahman, may the sacrifice be performed according to tradition in such a manner that the sacrifice is performed unhindered.

verses.transliteration: bhavān snigdhaḥ suhṛn mahyam guruḥ ca paramo mahān ।voḍhavyo bhavatā ca eva bhāro yajñasya ca udyataḥ ॥1-13-4॥

translations.english: You are an affectionate friend and most reverential spiritual guide to me. The burden of performing the sacrifice which has since commenced shall be borne by you".

verses.sloka: तथा इति च स राजानम् अब्रवीत् द्विजसत्तमः ।करिष्ये सर्वम् एव एतत् भवता यत् समर्थितम् ॥१-१३-५॥
verses.transliteration: tathā iti ca sa rājānam abravīt dvijasattamaḥ ।kariṣye sarvam eva etat bhavatā yat samarthitam ॥1-13-5॥

translations.english: The great among brahmins answered him saying "I shall do everything as proposed by you".

verses.transliteration: tato'bravīt dvijān vṛddhān yajña karmasu niṣṭhitān ।sthāpatye niṣṭhitām ca eva vṛddhān parama dhārmikān ॥1-13-6॥

translations.english: Thereafter Vasishta summoned those brahmins who are experienced in the sacrificerelated activities venerable and righteous architects skilled workers brick makers, carpenters, diggers, artisans, account keepers, dancers and actors, men versed in scriptures and honest, wellinformed people and addressed them saying, "In accordance with the king's command let the work of the sacrificial ceremony be inauguarated. Let thousands of bricks be brought. Let temporary residential buildings be erected with all the comforts to accommodate royal guests."

Let thousands of bricks be brought. Let temporary residential buildings be erected with all the comforts to accommodate royal guests."

verses.sloka: ब्राह्मण आवसथाः चैव कर्तव्याः शतशः शुभाः ।भक्ष्य अन्न पानैः बहुभिः समुपेताः सुनिष्ठिताः ॥१-१३-१०॥

translations.english: Let auspicious residences for the brahmins be prepared in their hundreds, well arranged and furnished with abundant food and drink.

translations.english: In the same way people coming from rural areas also should be duly, not casualy treated with respect.
translations.hindi: सवथा प्राप्स्यसे पुत्रांशचतुरो5मितविक्रमान्‌ । यस्य ते धार्मिकी बुद्धिरियं पुत्राथमागता !१२॥ जब आपकी बुद्धि पुत्र-प्राप्ति के लिए ऐसी धर्ममयी हो रही है, तब निश्चय ही आपके अमित पराक्रमी चार पुत्र उत्पन्न होंगे

translations.english: People from all castes should be welltreated with respect. There should be no insult to any one through lust on greed on anger.

translations.english: The people deeply immersed in performing sacrificerelated activities and sculptors be specially honoured according to their nature of work. All of them should be satisfied with money and food.

translations.english: Every thing should be wellmanaged. In whatever manner you do, not even the smallest things be left out. Carry out the work with love and affection in your hearts".

translations.english: Then all of them approached Vasishta and said, "everything has been wellarranged in accordance with your instruction. There is no deficiency. Everything will be done as instructed by you without leaving out anything."

verses.transliteration: yathā sarvam suvihitam na kiṁcit parihīyate ।tathā bhavantaḥ kurvantu prīti yuktena cetasā ॥1-13-17॥

verses.transliteration: tataḥ sarve samāgamya vasiṣṭham idam abruvan ।yatheṣṭam tat suvihitam na kiṁcit parihīyate ॥1-13-18॥

translations.english: You may personally go and bring with due honour king Janaka who is the distinguished king of Mithila, a warrior whose truth is his strength proficient in all scriptures and the Vedas. Since he is an old ally, I am telling you in advance.

translations.english: Similarly, you may personally escort king of Kasi who is always affectionate and sweettongued. He is a friend to our king who is a lion among rulers.

translations.english: Likewise bring here the aged and very righteous king of Kekaya along with his sons. He is fatherinlaw to this lion among kings (Dasaratha).

verses.transliteration: tathā kekaya rājānam vṛddham parama dhārmikam ।śvaśuram rāja siṁhasya saputram tvam iha ānaya ॥1-13-24॥

translations.english: Bring with honour king of Anga, Romapada, famous and prosperous. He is an intimate friend of the king (Dasaratha).

verses.sloka: अङ्गेश्वरम् महेष्वासम् रोमपादम् सु सत्कृतम् ।वयस्यम् राज सिंहस्य सपुत्रम् तम् इह आनय ॥१-१३-२५॥
verses.transliteration: aṅgeśvaram maheṣvāsam romapādam su satkṛtam ।vayasyam rāja siṁhasya saputram tam iha ānaya ॥1-13-25॥

translations.english: Bring kings from the countries of the eastern and southern regions, from Sindhu, Sauvera and Saurashtra৷৷

verses.sloka: तथा कोसल राजानम् भानुमंतम् सुसत्कृतम् ।मगध अधिपतिम् शूरम् सर्व शास्त्र विशारदम् ॥१-१३-२६॥
verses.transliteration: tathā kosala rājānam bhānumaṁtam susatkṛtam ।magadha adhipatim śūram sarva śāstra viśāradam ॥1-13-26॥

translations.english: Bring all other kings of this earth, who are friendly with us. Along with their retinues, families and relatives".

verses.sloka: प्राप्तिज्ञम् परमोदारम् सुसत्कृतम् पुरुषर्षभम् ।राज्ञः शासनम् आदाय चोदयस्व नृपर्षभान् ।प्राचीनान् सिन्धु सौवीरान् सौराष्ठ्रेयाम् च पार्थिवान् ॥१-१३-२७॥
verses.transliteration: prāptijñam paramodāram susatkṛtam puruṣarṣabham ।rājñaḥ śāsanam ādāya codayasva nṛparṣabhān ।prācīnān sindhu sauvīrān saurāṣṭhreyām ca pārthivān ॥1-13-27॥

translations.english: Having heard the words of Vasishta, Sumantra speedily despatched virtuous and auspicious emissaries to bring the kings.

verses.sloka: दाक्षिणात्यान् नरेन्द्राम् च समस्तान् आनयस्व ह ।सन्ति स्निग्धाः च ये च अन्ये राजानः पृथिवी तले ॥१-१३-२८॥
verses.transliteration: dākṣiṇātyān narendrām ca samastān ānayasva ha ।santi snigdhāḥ ca ye ca anye rājānaḥ pṛthivī tale ॥1-13-28॥

translations.english: In accordance with the ascetic's order, righteous Sumantra himself quickly set out to escort Janaka and other kings.

verses.sloka: तान् आनय यथा क्षिप्रम् स अनुगान् सह बान्धवान् ।एतान् दूतैः महाभागैः आनयस्व नृप आज्ञ्या ॥१-१३-२९॥
verses.transliteration: tān ānaya yathā kṣipram sa anugān saha bāndhavān ।etān dūtaiḥ mahābhāgaiḥ ānayasva nṛpa ājñyā ॥1-13-29॥

translations.english: All the workers reported to the wise sage, Vasishta about the tasks completed for the sacrifice.

verses.sloka: वसिष्ठ वाक्यम् तत् श्रुत्वा सुमंत्रः त्वरितः तदा ।व्यादिशत् पुरुषान् तत्र राज्ञाम् आनयने शुभान् ॥१-१३-३०॥
verses.transliteration: vasiṣṭha vākyam tat śrutvā sumaṁtraḥ tvaritaḥ tadā ।vyādiśat puruṣān tatra rājñām ānayane śubhān ॥1-13-30॥

translations.english: Then, well pleased, the best among brahmins (Vasishta) said to them all "Nobody should be offered any thing with disregard. Anything given with contempt undoubtedly results in the destruction of the donor."

verses.sloka: स्वयम् एव हि धर्मात्मा प्रयातो मुनि शासनात् ।सुमंत्रः त्वरितो भूत्वा समानेतुम् महामतिः ॥१-१३-३१॥
verses.transliteration: svayam eva hi dharmātmā prayāto muni śāsanāt ।sumaṁtraḥ tvarito bhūtvā samānetum mahāmatiḥ ॥1-13-31॥

translations.english: Meanwhile kings from several countries to travelling nights and days arrived bringing with them various kinds of (precious) gifts.

verses.sloka: ते च कर्मान्तिकाः सर्वे वसिष्ठाय च महर्षये ।सर्वम् निवेदयन्ति स्म यज्ञे यत् उपकल्पितम् ॥१-१३-३२॥
verses.transliteration: te ca karmāntikāḥ sarve vasiṣṭhāya ca maharṣaye ।sarvam nivedayanti sma yajñe yat upakalpitam ॥1-13-32॥

translations.english: Thereupon, wellpleased, Vasishta addressing Dasaratha said "O best among men, beacuse of your command, kings from various countries have arrived. I have extended due hospitality to those noble kings according to their station."

verses.sloka: ततः प्रीतो द्विज श्रेष्ठः तान् सर्वान् मुनिर् अब्रवीत् ।अवज्ञया न दातव्यम् कस्य चित् लीलया अपि वा ॥१-१३-३३॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prīto dvija śreṣṭhaḥ tān sarvān munir abravīt ।avajñayā na dātavyam kasya cit līlayā api vā ॥1-13-33॥

translations.english: Thereupon, wellpleased, Vasishta addressing Dasaratha said "O best among men, beacuse of your command, kings from various countries have arrived. I have extended due hospitality to those noble kings according to their station."

verses.sloka: अवज्ञया कृतम् हन्यात् दातारम् न अत्र संशयः ।ततः कैश्चित् अहो रात्रैः उपयाता महीक्षितः ॥१-१३-३४॥
verses.transliteration: avajñayā kṛtam hanyāt dātāram na atra saṁśayaḥ ।tataḥ kaiścit aho rātraiḥ upayātā mahīkṣitaḥ ॥1-13-34॥

translations.english: "O king, persons with composed minds have made preparations for the yaga. Now be pleased to leave for sacrificial altar nearby to perform yaga.

verses.sloka: बहूनि रत्नानि आदाय राज्ञो दशरथस्य ह ।ततो वसिष्ठः सुप्रीतो राजानम् इदम् अब्रवीत् ॥१-१३-३५॥
verses.transliteration: bahūni ratnāni ādāya rājño daśarathasya ha ।tato vasiṣṭhaḥ suprīto rājānam idam abravīt ॥1-13-35॥

translations.english: O foremost of kings, you ought to see the sacrificial ground full of sources of entertainment arranged everywhere, as though improvised by imagination".

verses.sloka: उपयाता नर व्याघ्र राजानः तव शासनात् ।मया अपि सत्कृताः सर्वे यथा अर्हम् राज सत्तम ॥१-१३-३६॥
verses.transliteration: upayātā nara vyāghra rājānaḥ tava śāsanāt ।mayā api satkṛtāḥ sarve yathā arham rāja sattama ॥1-13-36॥

translations.english: In response to the words of Vasishta and Rsyasringa, the Lord of the earth (Dasaratha) entered the sacrificial pavilion on a favourable day presided over by an auspicious star.

verses.sloka: यज्ञीयम् च कृतम् सर्वम् पुरुषैः सुसमाहितैः ।निर्यातु च भवान् यष्टुम् यज्ञ आयतनम् अन्तिकात् ॥१-१३-३७॥
verses.transliteration: yajñīyam ca kṛtam sarvam puruṣaiḥ susamāhitaiḥ ।niryātu ca bhavān yaṣṭum yajña āyatanam antikāt ॥1-13-37॥

translations.english: At that moment the best of brahmins led by Vasishta and headed by Rsyasringa, entered the sacrificial enclosure and began the sacrifice in accordance with traditions and scriptural stipulations. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे त्रयोदशस्सर्ग:।। Thus ends the thirteenth sarga of Balakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

verses.sloka: सर्वकामैः उपहृतैः उपेतम् वै समन्ततः ।द्रष्टुम् अर्हसि राजेन्द्र मनसेव विनिर्मितम् ॥१-१३-३८॥
verses.transliteration: sarvakāmaiḥ upahṛtaiḥ upetam vai samantataḥ ।draṣṭum arhasi rājendra manaseva vinirmitam ॥1-13-38॥

verses.sloka: तथा वसिष्ठ वचनात् ऋष्यशृन्गस्य च उभयोः ।दिवसे शुभ नक्षत्रे निर्यातो जगतीपतिः ॥१-१३-३९॥
verses.transliteration: tathā vasiṣṭha vacanāt ṛṣyaśṛngasya ca ubhayoḥ ।divase śubha nakṣatre niryāto jagatīpatiḥ ॥1-13-39॥

verses.sloka: ततो वसिष्ठ प्रमुखाः सर्व एव द्विजोत्तमाः ।ऋष्यशृन्गम् पुरस्कृत्य यज्ञ कर्म आरभन् तदा ॥१-१३-४०॥
verses.transliteration: tato vasiṣṭha pramukhāḥ sarva eva dvijottamāḥ ।ṛṣyaśṛngam puraskṛtya yajña karma ārabhan tadā ॥1-13-40॥

verses.sloka: यज्ञ वाटम् गताः सर्वे यथा शास्त्रम् यथा विधि ।श्रीमान् च सह पत्नीभी राजा दीक्षाम् उपाविशत् ॥१-१३-४१॥
verses.transliteration: yajña vāṭam gatāḥ sarve yathā śāstram yathā vidhi ।śrīmān ca saha patnībhī rājā dīkṣām upāviśat ॥1-13-41॥
